Name: ATK_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the hitbox and damage parameters for attacks.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Radius
Fields.Description: Size of this hit's striking zone around its anchor point. Raise it to catch targets standing further off. Set it to 0 to disable this hit.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Radius
Fields.Description: Size of this hit's striking zone around its anchor point. Raise it to catch targets standing further off. Set it to 0 to disable this hit.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Radius
Fields.Description: Size of this hit's striking zone around its anchor point. Raise it to catch targets standing further off. Set it to 0 to disable this hit.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Radius
Fields.Description: Size of this hit's striking zone around its anchor point. Raise it to catch targets standing further off. Set it to 0 to disable this hit.

Fields.Name: Knockback Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: How far the victim slides when this attack staggers them. It may move the attacker instead when the victim holds firm, but this is not established.

Fields.Name: Hit Stop Time (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long the impact freezes motion when this hit lands. Higher values make hits feel heavier. 0 removes the pause.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 0
Fields.Description: Extra effect this attack puts on the victim, such as poison or a stat change. Attacks fired as bullets ignore this and use the bullet's own effect slots instead.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 1
Fields.Description: Extra effect this attack puts on the victim, such as poison or a stat change. Attacks fired as bullets ignore this and use the bullet's own effect slots instead.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 2
Fields.Description: Extra effect this attack puts on the victim, such as poison or a stat change. Attacks fired as bullets ignore this and use the bullet's own effect slots instead.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 3
Fields.Description: Extra effect this attack puts on the victim, such as poison or a stat change. Attacks fired as bullets ignore this and use the bullet's own effect slots instead.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 4
Fields.Description: Extra effect this attack puts on the victim, such as poison or a stat change. Attacks fired as bullets ignore this and use the bullet's own effect slots instead.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Anchor point on the attacker where this hit sits. For a capsule hit, this marks one end. -1 probably leaves this hit with no anchor, so it never lands.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Anchor point on the attacker where this hit sits. For a capsule hit, this marks one end. -1 probably leaves this hit with no anchor, so it never lands.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Anchor point on the attacker where this hit sits. For a capsule hit, this marks one end. -1 probably leaves this hit with no anchor, so it never lands.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Anchor point on the attacker where this hit sits. For a capsule hit, this marks one end. -1 probably leaves this hit with no anchor, so it never lands.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Secondary Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Second anchor point, which stretches this hit into a capsule between the two points. Set -1 to keep it a sphere on the first point only.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Secondary Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Second anchor point, which stretches this hit into a capsule between the two points. Set -1 to keep it a sphere on the first point only.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Secondary Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Second anchor point, which stretches this hit into a capsule between the two points. Set -1 to keep it a sphere on the first point only.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Secondary Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Second anchor point, which stretches this hit into a capsule between the two points. Set -1 to keep it a sphere on the first point only.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Blow-off
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may scale how far this attack launches the victim, but this is not established.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Physical
Fields.Description: Percent of this hit's physical damage that lands. 100 applies the full value.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Magic
Fields.Description: Percent of this hit's magic damage that lands. 100 applies the full value. For bows, it scales the fired arrow instead.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Fire
Fields.Description: Percent of this hit's fire damage that lands. 100 applies the full value. For bows, it scales the fired arrow instead.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Lightning
Fields.Description: Percent of this hit's lightning damage that lands. 100 applies the full value. For bows, it scales the fired arrow instead.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Stamina
Fields.Description: Multiplies the stamina damage this hit deals to a blocking victim. Player attacks only. 100 keeps the weapon's full stamina damage.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Guard Attack
Fields.Description: Multiplies the weapon's deflection attack for this hit. Player attacks only. The game compares it with the target's deflection defense to decide whether this attack rebounds.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Guard Defense
Fields.Description: Multiplies the weapon's deflection defense for this hit. Player attacks only. Higher values probably stop this attack rebounding off blocks and walls.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Throw Attack
Fields.Description: Scales weapon damage on grab attacks the victim can break out of. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Poise
Fields.Description: Multiplies the weapon's poise damage for this hit. Player attacks only. Higher values stagger victims through their armor more often.

Fields.Name: Damage: Physical
Fields.Description: Physical damage of this hit, in points of health for enemies. Player swings deal a motion value instead: percent of the weapon's attack rating. 100 deals the full rating.

Fields.Name: Damage: Magic
Fields.Description: Magic damage of this hit, in points of health for enemies. Player swings deal a motion value instead: percent of the weapon's attack rating. 100 deals the full rating.

Fields.Name: Damage: Fire
Fields.Description: Fire damage of this hit, in points of health for enemies. Player swings deal a motion value instead: percent of the weapon's attack rating. 100 deals the full rating.

Fields.Name: Damage: Lightning
Fields.Description: Lightning damage of this hit, in points of health for enemies. Player swings deal a motion value instead: percent of the weapon's attack rating. 100 deals the full rating.

Fields.Name: Damage: Stamina
Fields.Description: Stamina damage this hit deals to a blocking victim. Enemy attacks only. Higher values break blocks faster.

Fields.Name: Damage: Guard Attack
Fields.Description: Flat deflection attack of this hit. Enemy attacks only. The game compares it with the target's deflection defense to decide whether this attack rebounds.

Fields.Name: Damage: Guard Defense
Fields.Description: Flat deflection defense of this hit. Enemy attacks only. Higher values stop this attack rebounding off blocks and walls.

Fields.Name: Damage: Poise
Fields.Description: Poise damage of this hit. Enemy attacks only. Higher values stagger victims through their armor more often.

Fields.Name: Damage: Throw Attack
Fields.Description: Flat damage for grab attacks the victim can break out of. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Damage: Object Destruction
Fields.Description: Damage this hit deals to breakable objects. Objects with less HP than this break. High values smash barriers in one hit.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Correction: Stamina
Fields.Description: Shifts the victim's block stability against this hit. 0 keeps their stability, -50 halves it. Positive values make blocking this hit cheaper.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption
Fields.Description: Shifts how much damage blocking stops against this hit. 0 keeps the shield's block rate, -100 removes it. Positive values make the block stronger.

Fields.Name: Throw Type ID
Fields.Description: Names the grab linked to this attack. Which table it points to is not established.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Special behavior of this hit. 0 is a normal hit. 2 rebounds off walls and objects.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Special behavior of this hit. 0 is a normal hit. 2 rebounds off walls and objects.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Special behavior of this hit. 0 is a normal hit. 2 rebounds off walls and objects.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Special behavior of this hit. 0 is a normal hit. 2 rebounds off walls and objects.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Priority
Fields.Description: Which hit wins when two of this attack's hits land at once. Higher values win. It does nothing when only one hit lands.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Priority
Fields.Description: Which hit wins when two of this attack's hits land at once. Higher values win. It does nothing when only one hit lands.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Priority
Fields.Description: Which hit wins when two of this attack's hits land at once. Higher values win. It does nothing when only one hit lands.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Priority
Fields.Description: Which hit wins when two of this attack's hits land at once. Higher values win. It does nothing when only one hit lands.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Hostile
Fields.Description: How hard the victim staggers. No Stagger plays no reaction, while Small Stagger, Large Stagger, and Blown Away play bigger ones.

Fields.Name: Map Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which walls and floors this attack tests against. The meaning of each value is not established.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Invalidation
Fields.Description: How much of the victim's block this attack ignores. 0 keeps the block, -100 removes it. Positive values strengthen the block instead.

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute
Fields.Description: The physical damage type, such as slash or thrust. Some enemies resist certain types. Pick the one that matches the weapon's motion.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: The visual and sound theme of this hit, such as fire or lightning. It also picks the victim's death animation.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation Type
Fields.Description: The look and sound theme of this hit. It joins the material and size as one set. Match it to the attack's damage type.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation: Material
Fields.Description: The material flash and sound of this hit, such as fire or lightning. It joins the attack theme and size as one set.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation: Size
Fields.Description: The scale of this hit's look and sound. Always leave it blank or small. The spare sizes still take effect, so avoid them.

Fields.Name: Defense Presentation: Material
Fields.Description: The clang this attack makes when blocked. Match it to the attacker's weapon material.

Fields.Name: Defense Presentation: Particles
Fields.Description: The sparks this attack shows when blocked. Match it to the attacker's weapon material.

Fields.Name: Hit Source Type
Fields.Description: Which model carries this attack's anchor points. Weapon reads them from the weapon, Body from the attacker. Parts suit multi-part enemies.

Fields.Name: Throw Type
Fields.Description: Marks how this attack behaves as a grab. The meaning of each value is not established.

Fields.Name: Ignore Guard
Fields.Description: Makes this attack go through blocks. The victim staggers as if unguarded. Use it for unblockable moves.

Fields.Name: Disable Guard Drain
Fields.Description: Stops this attack draining a blocking victim's stamina. The guard-break check still runs as normal.

Fields.Name: Disable Hit SpEffect
Fields.Description: Stops this attack applying its extra effect slots to the victim. The slots stay set but do nothing while this is on.

Fields.Name: Disable Missed Attack Notification
Fields.Description: Hides this attack's misses from enemy AI. Enemies will not react to a whiffed swing. Leave it off so enemies notice dodged attacks.

Fields.Name: Repeat Hit Particles
Fields.Description: Repeats the wall-impact effect while this attack touches a wall. Enemy attacks only.

Fields.Name: Enable Part Destruction
Fields.Description: Lets this attack damage severable enemy parts such as tails. Turn it on for arrows and other projectiles. Its exact scope is not established.

Fields.Name: Enable Ghost Destruction
Fields.Description: Lets this attack harm ghosts. Without it, ghost enemies take no damage.

Fields.Name: Ignore Invulnerability Frames
Fields.Description: Makes this attack hit through dodge rolls. Fully scripted invincibility still blocks it.
